title: Build organization Workforce HQ
goal: Make departments, accountable managers, workforce health, and prioritized attention the default Admin workforce experience.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Admins can identify unmanaged departments, absences, coverage gaps, blockers, and overdue work without opening the calendar
Every attention item deep-links to its affected department and record
Internal and vendor departments share one hierarchy
Degraded sources remain visibly unavailable and large department sets remain usable

progress.summary: Blocked on the routed Workforce command shell.
next_steps: CP-103 partition: app/admin/dashboard/staff/** and components/admin/workforce/** are carved out of ADMVIEW-001 for the WFC admin lanes. components/admin/workforce/event-worker-attendance.tsx stays with WORK-006, and the seven pre-existing files in components/admin/workforce/ stay ADMVIEW-001's to repair. Build only under components/admin/workforce/**; shared primitives come from WFC-007 in components/ui/** and must not be re-authored here (CP-101).

handoffs: Admin → WFC-010: stable department selection and attention navigation
Admin → WFC-021: HQ persona and degraded-state journeys
